item.title: Why Trump just loosened the rules on 'dyed diesel' — normally a farm fuel
item.description: Trump is temporarily allowing this fuel to be used on highways, although it's typically just for off-road farm and construction vehicles. Could that lower the price of diesel?

item.title: How Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth has brought the culture wars to the military
item.description: The New York Times reporter Greg Jaffe says Hegseth has disproportionately blocked promotions of Black and women senior officers, and he's also been purging the military of transgender people.
item.content:encoded: The New York Times reporter Greg Jaffe says Hegseth has disproportionately blocked promotions of Black and women senior officers, and he's also been purging the military of transgender people.

item.title: She got Trump's $500 check for health insurance. To her, it's a 'political stunt'
item.description: As checks from President Trump for health costs hit millions of mailboxes, a poll shows Americans don't trust Republicans on healthcare. Experts doubt it will move the needle and say it is likely illegal.

item.title: Gut microbes followed migrating humans across continents, new study suggests
item.description: New research looks at the surprising similarities in the gut microbiomes of hunter-gathers in Tanzania and horticulturalists in Bolivia, and asks: What role do these bacteria play in human health?

item.title: Greetings from Lahore, Pakistan, whose high court offers an oasis for chatter and chai
item.description: The Lahore High Court is a near-perfect specimen of British South Asian colonial architecture and its main square is a pleasant spot shaded by banyan trees.

item.title: DIY fertilizer is a blessing as farmers face steep prices due to the Iran war
item.description: It's hard enough being a small-scale farmer. Then the Iran war drove up fertilizer prices. So farmers are using a traditional Asian recipe to make their own. They call it a "labor of love."

item.title: U.S. moves long-range bombers from U.K. And, Israel allegedly warned before Oct. 7
item.description: A possible Iranian threat led the U.S. to remove long-range bombers from a U.K. base. And, Israelis are learning that their prime minister may have been warned before the Oct. 7 attacks.

item.title: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai win Nobel Prize in chemistry
item.description: Henri B. Kagan and Kenso Soai won the Nobel Prize in chemistry Wednesday for their discovery of non-linear effects and autocatalysis in asymmetric organic synthesis.

item.title: Over 1,000 children are buried at juvenile detention centers nationwide
item.description: Researchers uncovered the graves of more than 1,000 children next to juvenile detention facilities in 29 states. At one Maryland gravesite, 230 Black boys are buried.
